Web VPython 3.2


# axes, objects

x_axis = arrow(pos=vec(0,0,0), axis=vector(10,0,0), shaftwidth=0.1)
y_axis = arrow(pos=vec(0,-2,0), axis=vector(0,4,0), shaftwidth=0.1)
connection_line = box(opacity = 0.5)  
circle_height_line = box(opacity = 0.5, color = vec(1,0,0))
sine_height_line = box(opacity = 0.5, color = vec(1,0,0))
rad_line = arrow(pos=vec(0,0,0),axis = vector(1,0,0),shaftwidth=0.1)


# circle, sine function

circle_point = sphere(radius = 0.01, make_trail = True, color = vec(0,1,0))
sine_point = sphere(radius = 0.01, make_trail = True, color = vec(0,1,0))

# height_line function

def height_line(line_, point) :
    line_.size = vec(0.1, point.pos.y, 0.1)
    line_.pos.x = point.pos.x
    line_.pos.y = point.pos.y - (line_.size.y * 0.5)

## Labeling

# Title, explanation  
label( pos=vec(-5,5,0), text='+++ sine fucntion +++ ' , border=1, box=False)
label( pos=vec(-5,4,0), text=' : click to start, reclick to stop' , border=1, box=False)

# Numbers on Axes
label( pos=vec(pi,-0.5,0), text='pi' , border=1, box=False)
label( pos=vec(0.5*pi,-0.5,0), text='pi/2' , border=1, box=False)
label( pos=vec((3/2)*pi,-0.5,0), text='(3/2)pi' , border=1, box=False)
label( pos=vec(2*pi,-0.5,0), text='2pi' , border=1, box=False)

label( pos=vec(0.1,1.3,0), text=' :1' , border=1, box=False)
label( pos=vec(0.1,-1.5,0), text=' :-1' , border=1, box=False)
label( pos=vec(0.4,-0.3,0), text=' :1' , border=1, box=False)
label( pos=vec(-1,-0.3,0), text=' :-1' , border=1, box=False)

# Moving Points
circle_point_label = label( pos=vec(1,0,0), text='P' , border=1, box=False)
sine_point_label = label( pos=vec(0,0,0), text='Q' , border=1, box=False)


## Click Control

onclick = 0

def click(event):
    global onclick
    print(' ')
    onclick = not onclick
    
scene.bind('click', click)

## Graphing

t=0
        


while True : 
    rate(7)
    if onclick :     
        t += 0.1
        # Setting Points
        circle_point.pos = vec(cos(t), sin(t), 0)
        sine_point.pos = vec(t, sin(t), 0)
        # Connection Line
        connection_line.size = vec(abs(circle_point.pos.x - sine_point.pos.x),0.05,0.05)
        connection_line.pos.x = circle_point.pos.x + ( 0.5 * connection_line.size.x )
        connection_line.pos.y = circle_point.pos.y
        # Angle_Line 
        rad_line.axis = circle_point.pos - rad_line.pos

        # Height Lines
        height_line(circle_height_line, circle_point)
        height_line(sine_height_line, sine_point)
        # Moving Labels of Points P,Q
        circle_point_label.pos = circle_point.pos
        sine_point_label.pos = sine_point.pos
